scenario: 220 Hz note with a re-attack at 0.6 s at the same pitch; transposed +7 st

columns.attackRiseMs: 10%→90% envelope rise at the re-attack (lower = sharper)
columns.postOnsetPitchSdHz: pitch scatter over 150 ms after the attack (lower = steadier)
columns.attackWindowAmplitude: amplitude of the target partial in the first 30 ms after the attack
columns.comparedToContinue: correlation / mean absolute difference against continue mode at the attack

conclusion: Continue mode keeps the pitch trajectory smooth but reconstructs the attack from propagated phases; reset mode rebuilds the attack coherently, changing the waveform at the attack while the sustained portion stays pitch-stable. Resetting every frame scatters the pitch considerably, which is why auto mode only resets when onset reliability is high.
